note: Copy this file to relay-settings.json and change the values. projects_dir: the folder with your code repositories. worktrees_dir (optional): where workers work; without it, <projects_dir>\_worktrees\claude. owner_name (optional): your name for the relay's notes. worker_tools (optional): the AI tools that may run workers, from claude, codex and gemini; without it, only claude. Codex and Gemini workers stay off until you add them, and Gemini costs money for every run. claude_exe, codex_exe and gemini_exe (optional): the full paths of those programs; without them, Claude Code's usual place, and codex or gemini from your PATH. codex_exe is for the Codex wake too. Only for the Codex wake (bridge-relay.ps1 -EnrollCodex): codex_exec_args (optional) is a list of extra codex exec options, one per entry, such as ["--sandbox", "workspace-write"].
